Guest-agnostic scalar-FP intrinsic -> x86_64 SSE lowering for the ARM64
optimizing backend. These mirror the riscv64 binding for the four basic
scalar FP arithmetic intrinsics (FADD/FSUB/FMUL/FDIV, Float32 and Float64,
with the AVX three-operand variants). The referenced x86 SSE ops are all
defined in the shared assembler defs (insn_def_x86.json), so the LIR gen
allowlist resolves cleanly without pulling in any riscv64-only macro defs.
FCvtFloatToInteger / FeGetExceptions / FeSetExceptionsAndRound are NOT bound
here: their macro-assembler defs live only in riscv64_to_x86_64/macro_def.json
(not in the ARM64 backend gen inputs), so those guest ops bail to the lite
translator / interpreter for now.
